about: Fifteen Days pre-production, step 2: the 8-shot courtyard consistency test (owner, 2026-10-16). Every reference in: the courtyard plate (with robot C), one face-and-costume card per person, the floor plan in words. Bai's and Deluin's faces are provisional. Prompts DRAFTED by the coding agent; people described, never named.

jobs.prompt: Extreme wide establishing shot from high on the west side of the courtyard: the spiky-haired young man walks in through the far gate, looking around; at the wide table the tall young man and the young woman are laughing together, well apart across it; the serving robot glides between tables; other diners all around. The table: one wide rectangular table for four with plenty of room between the chairs; the tall young man sits on its far side, the young woman across from him on the near side, and the spiky-haired young man at its right-hand end, at right angles to both; a small round table for one stands just beyond that end. Reference image 1 is the place: draw this same courtyard cafe, its buildings, tree, string lights, skyline and its serving robot exactly. Reference image 2 is the slim young man with spiky black hair with a blue streak and an orange cropped jacket: copy only that person's face, hair, skin and clothes from it, never the sheet's layout, poses or grey background. Reference image 3 is the thin, wiry young woman with deep brown skin, shaved sides and a tall magenta ponytail, a lime-green vest and tattooed arms: copy only that person's face, hair, skin and clothes from it, never the sheet's layout, poses or grey background. Reference image 4 is the tall young man with wavy shoulder-length light-brown hair and a long cream cable-knit tunic: copy only that person's face, hair, skin and clothes from it, never the sheet's layout, poses or grey background. Exactly three main people, each appearing once. Any other diners are small, far off and plainly dressed. Detailed science fiction comic art at night: precise fine uniform linework, cel-shaded flat color, a deep blue and violet night with glowing practical lights, pools of warm and cool light on faces and surfaces, crisp silhouettes, clear readable faces and hands. Wherever the sky shows, enormous megastructures and towering buildings fill the far distance and the horizon, their lit windows and beacons glowing against the night, rich mechanical and architectural detail kept to the middle and far distance. Another time and place, not the Earth we know: unfamiliar architecture, no recognisable landmarks, vehicles or brands. Shop fronts and walls carry no lettered signs at all: at most a plain glowing panel with one single large simple pictogram (a cup, a leaf, a bowl) and nothing else. Screens show only abstract shapes. No letters, words, digits or numbers anywhere. No text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers. No cartoon murals or cartoon animals, and nothing that resembles a known character.
jobs.note: courtyard consistency test; Bai and Deluin faces PROVISIONAL (face-bai-c, face-deluin-c)
